stories.title: Ritu Kumar on her design legacy
stories.summary: Ritu Kumar is credited with transforming India’s fashion industry by blending traditional craftsmanship with modern aesthetics. Often regarded as a pioneer of boutique fashion culture in India, she built a legacy by focusing on the country’s textile heritage. Her work remains a staple of Indian design history.

stories.title: Raw Mango pursues handloom business
stories.summary: Raw Mango founder Sanjay Garg is working with handloom weavers to build a business model based on specialised skills rather than celebrity machinery. The company aims to persuade consumers that fabric value exceeds raw material costs. It is a difficult path, as the market prefers celebrity-led luxury.

stories.title: QUE Universe eyes Rs 100 crore revenue
stories.summary: Eyewear brand QUE Universe, backed by cricketer Shikhar Dhawan, is targeting Rs 100 crore in revenue and one million customers within two years. The company plans to expand its omnichannel retail strategy into the UAE. It currently operates with a digital-first model across key Indian markets.

stories.title: Zara renames leather yoga mat
stories.summary: Zara has renamed a cow leather yoga mat after Hindu groups protested the product as insensitive to religious beliefs. The item, previously listed for $399, was rebranded following an apology from Inditex. The company stated that the original naming was not intended to cause offense.

stories.summary: Martine Rose will become creative director of Balenciaga on November 16, succeeding Pierpaolo Piccioli. She is the first Black person and the first woman to lead the house. Rose previously worked with the brand to shape its menswear. The appointment continues a long history of design leadership.

stories.title: Burberry reports revenue growth
stories.summary: Burberry reported a 6 percent rise in first-half revenue to 1.1 billion pounds, with profits reaching 54 million pounds. The brand attributed the growth to supply chain improvements and a shift toward full-price sales. Adjusted operating margins rose to 5.7 percent during the period.

stories.title: Burberry retail sales rise 4 percent
stories.summary: Burberry recorded its fifth consecutive quarter of retail sales growth, up 4 percent in the second quarter. Performance was led by the Americas and Greater China, while EMEIA regions saw a 2 percent decline. The company reported growth across womenswear, menswear, childrenswear, and accessories categories.

stories.title: Shenkar students present fashion collection
stories.summary: Shenkar’s Department of Fashion Design showcased 75 looks by 75 students at Tel Aviv Fashion Week 2026. The presentation included a live design installation and a runway show exploring themes such as the climate crisis, body image, and consumer culture. The event highlighted experimental materials and local craftsmanship.

stories.title: Zimmermann hosts cruise 2027 event
stories.summary: Zimmermann celebrated its cruise 2027 collection with a party in New York City attended by Katie Holmes, Uma Thurman, and Naomi Watts. The collection, which debuted on the Côte d’Azur, features ruffled gowns and lace. The lineup is now officially available in stores for the holiday season.

stories.title: London exhibition features Japanese youth fashion
stories.summary: Japan House London has opened an exhibition titled Tradition/Rebellion, showcasing the flamboyant fashion of Kitakyushu’s coming-of-age ceremonies. The display highlights the rebellious Yankii subculture and the work of artisans who create elaborate embroidered garments. The exhibition explores the intersection of traditional haori and modern youth expression.

stories.title: Bulgari Pink diamond sells for $14.8 million
stories.summary: A 24-carat fancy intense pink diamond, set in a Bulgari ring, sold for $14.8 million at Christie’s in Geneva. The auction house described the Type IIa stone as having exceptional rarity. It was estimated to sell for between $12 million and $18 million. The diamond remains rare.

stories.summary: Ada Diamonds has launched its Dreamscape collection, featuring celestial motifs and ceramic finishes. The brand says it wants to move away from the solitaire and tennis styles that have defined much of the lab-grown category. Too much of the category has been built around price.

stories.title: Angel Reese releases Reebok signature sneaker colorway
stories.summary: Reebok has revealed a new colorway of the Angel Reese 1 sneaker, inspired by the WNBA player's draft night gown. The shoe features a black-and-white liquid-metal finish. Reese said she wanted the colorway to reflect the energy of the night that started her professional career.

stories.title: UGG and Aimé Leon Dore release debut slipper
stories.summary: UGG and Aimé Leon Dore have released their debut footwear collaboration, the UGG ALD Slipper. The moccasin-inspired shoe is crafted from full-grain leather and features debossed branding. It launches November 12 in Dark Coffee Bean and Goldenrod colorways across both brands' flagships and online stores.

stories.title: Next extends Costa Coffee partnership for a decade
stories.summary: Next will continue its partnership with Costa Coffee until 2036. The agreement covers more than 140 locations within the retailer’s UK estate. The partnership began in 2011 with a single concession, and further openings are planned over the next decade.

stories.title: Africa’s cotton manufacturing initiative launches
stories.summary: The Africa Made It campaign aims to expand domestic textile manufacturing, claiming it could contribute $34 billion annually to Africa’s GDP. The initiative focuses on lowering industrial energy costs, protecting domestic manufacturers from import competition, and encouraging consumers to buy locally made clothing.

stories.title: USDA cuts global cotton output forecast
stories.summary: The USDA has revised its global cotton production forecast downwards to 117.48 million bales for the current season. The reduction reflects smaller crop estimates for India, the US, Turkiye and Argentina, which offset higher production forecasts for China and Australia. Global supplies were also lowered.

stories.title: Global cotton prices remain subdued
stories.summary: Global cotton prices remain flat to slightly lower as the USDA trimmed its 2026-27 production forecast to 117.5 million bales. Mill-use projections were also cut to 122.7 million bales. Market participants continue to watch for signals regarding China's tariff and reserve-buying policies.

stories.title: Mayer and Cie to showcase knitting innovations
stories.summary: Mayer and Cie will exhibit two circular knitting machines and a Huixing model at India ITME in Greater Noida from December 4 to 9. The company says its starting point is the product that makes the customer successful, with machines tailored to specific quality and productivity requirements.

stories.title: Tirupur knitwear trade reaches 851 million dollars
stories.summary: Tirupur domestic knitwear trade hit 851 million dollars ahead of Diwali, up from last year's 777 to 798 million dollar range. Manufacturers noted the increase was driven by higher input costs and garment prices, while order volumes remained largely unchanged year-on-year.

stories.title: India online festive sales grow 17 percent
stories.summary: India's online festive sales reached 15 billion dollars in 2026, a 17 percent increase year-on-year. Ethnic wear recorded double-digit growth, though the broader apparel market saw mixed results. Several retailers reported sales figures that fell below industry expectations.

stories.title: Industry trends suggest speed is the new edge
stories.summary: Global textile trends for 2027 are expected to hinge on faster material decisions as regulation and cost pressures reshape sourcing. Brands are increasingly using 3D garment rendering and digital sampling to test designs before production. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: North India cotton yarn market remains sluggish
stories.summary: North India's cotton yarn market remains sluggish as factory operations recover from the Diwali holidays. Prices in Ludhiana and Delhi are stable amid limited buying. Traders expect demand to improve as production normalises and winter clothing consumption increases.

stories.title: US cotton futures fall for third session
stories.summary: US cotton futures have declined for the third consecutive session. The drop follows a strengthening of the dollar. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Inditex pledges 50 million dollars for green transition
stories.summary: Inditex has committed 50 million dollars to an IFC fund aimed at helping suppliers adopt energy-efficient machinery and renewable energy. The initiative seeks to raise 400 million dollars total to support net-zero business models. CEO Oscar Garcia Maceiras described the project as the first of its kind.

stories.title: MTU students host clothing swap
stories.summary: Students at Munster Technological University are hosting a clothing swap event on November 16 to encourage sustainable fashion and reduce textile waste. The event invites the community to refresh their wardrobes by swapping, buying, or selling pre-loved items in the university's business building.

stories.title: Cork woman promotes sustainable fashion
stories.summary: Ailís Crowley is working to help individuals and businesses extend the life of everyday items through sustainable practices. Her work follows a career in advertising and a trip to Sri Lanka, where she encountered companies turning discarded materials into new products.

stories.title: Middlebury students host thrift pop-up
stories.summary: The student fashion club Clover hosted a thrift pop-up at Middlebury College on November 6. Organisers aimed to bolster sustainable fashion culture by allowing students to sell clothes to their peers, keeping garments in circulation within the campus community.

stories.title: Noortribe showcases sustainable luxury
stories.summary: Noortribe presented a ten-look collection at Eco Fashion Week Africa, featuring reconstructed denim, silk, and repurposed materials. The brand combines Italian tailoring with Kenyan craftsmanship, highlighting the role of local production and artisans in its approach to sustainable luxury.

stories.title: Digital passports fall short on circularity
stories.summary: A report by Circular Fashion News found that only 18 percent of digital product passport pilots include features for repair, resale or recycling. Most current initiatives focus primarily on authentication or traceability. The industry is currently struggling to connect garments with circular services.

stories.title: Fashion fund targets factory emissions
stories.summary: A new 400 million dollar fund aims to address emissions within the fashion industry's supply chain. The initiative focuses on the effectiveness of financing for factory-level climate action. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Fashion industry faces climate pressure
stories.summary: As leaders gather for COP31, the fashion industry is facing increased scrutiny regarding its role in global emissions. Designers are being urged to integrate sustainability into the creative process rather than treating it as a marketing strategy. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Salvation Army hosts pre-loved fashion show
stories.summary: The Swindon Gorse Hill Salvation Army raised 900 pounds through a fashion show featuring second-hand clothing from its charity shop. The event was intended to demonstrate that sustainable fashion can be stylish and affordable. The venue was reported to be at capacity.

stories.title: Mizuno reports sales growth
stories.summary: Mizuno reported a 9.9 percent increase in sales for the first half of the year. The company has retained its financial outlook for 2027. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Perona targets festive growth
stories.summary: Premium western wear brand Perona is targeting 20 to 30 percent sales growth this festive season. The company currently operates one store in Gurgaon with two more in development in Mumbai. It is now exploring further expansion into Hyderabad and Bengaluru. The leatherwear segment remains a primary driver.

stories.title: ABFRL reports 2 percent revenue growth
stories.summary: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited reported revenue of INR2,030 crore for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, a 2 percent year on year increase. The company attributed the performance to a shifting festive calendar and a subdued wedding season. Emerging businesses provided the primary growth support.

stories.summary: PVH Corp, owner of Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger, plans to cut 4 percent of its workforce. The move is part of an enterprisewide initiative to improve productivity and profitability. The company aims to achieve $100 million in cost savings during fiscal year 2027.

stories.title: Lenskart announces Children's Day initiative
stories.summary: Lenskart will provide free prescription glasses with blue-light filtering lenses to the first 1 lakh eligible children aged 5 to 12 visiting its stores on November 14. The company currently serves 32 million eyewear units annually in India and aims to scale this to 100 million units.

stories.title: Lenskart targets 100 million eyewear units
stories.summary: Lenskart is targeting annual eyewear volumes of 100 million units in India, up from its current 32 million. CEO Peyush Bansal described the milestone as the next phase of the company's growth journey. The firm aims to significantly expand access to vision care across the country.

stories.title: Lenskart CEO reflects on IPO anniversary
stories.summary: One year after its public listing, Lenskart CEO Peyush Bansal has pledged free glasses to 100,000 children and ended blue-light lens upsells. Bansal acknowledged that despite the company's expansion, the core objective of making clear vision a universal reality in India remains an unfinished task for the firm.

stories.title: Maybelline adds virtual try-on to ChatGPT
stories.summary: Maybelline New York has introduced real-time makeup virtual try-on within ChatGPT. Powered by L’Oréal’s ModiFace technology, the service offers product recommendations and beauty advice in a conversational format. The brand is now offering its services directly within an AI platform to assist with the beauty shopping experience.

stories.title: Google Pixel and Highsnobiety conclude fashion program
stories.summary: Google Pixel and Highsnobiety have finished the first edition of their fashion and technology program in Berlin. The project featured work from independent designers using Google AI tools and Pixel phones. A second edition of the program is planned for 2027 with a new cohort of designers.

stories.title: Drifbolt enters Indian footwear market
stories.summary: Footwear brand Drifbolt is introducing 3D-printed shoes to India using AI-assisted manufacturing. The company claims its single-part design reduces material wastage and improves comfort compared to conventional assembly methods. The brand is positioning the technology as an alternative to traditional production processes for the local market.

stories.title: Brandman Retail targets 50 stores by 2027
stories.summary: Brandman Retail is targeting 50 stores by March 2027 to capture interest in international sports and lifestyle brands. The company reported revenue of INR162.41 crore in fiscal year 2026, up from INR135.22 crore the previous year. Expansion plans include deeper brand partnerships and growth in e-commerce.

stories.title: Amazon Bazaar grows in value-commerce market
stories.summary: Amazon Bazaar is emerging as a key player in India's value-commerce market, which is projected to reach $65 to 70 billion by 2030. Competitors include Meesho, Shopsy and Ajio Street. While metro penetration is higher, over 65 percent of online shoppers are estimated to come from smaller markets.

The runway shows will be created using state-of-the-art technology.

stories.summary: Jaipur-based QB MEN has raised pre-seed funding led by BeyondSeed to scale its printed menswear business. The brand plans to use the capital for content creation, customer experience, and distribution. It positions itself in the accessible premium segment by blending traditional Indian prints with contemporary designs.

stories.summary: Travel products platform Escape Plan has opened a 20,000 sq ft workspace in Bengaluru to consolidate its design, marketing, and operations teams. Founded in 2025, the company manages product development and distribution for partners including HRX and Rare Rabbit. The office serves as a central hub for expansion.

stories.summary: Marks and Spencer has partnered with Global Fashion Group to sell its apparel on ZALORA and THE ICONIC.
